product.name: Meowcal Sub
product.tagline: Local subtitle translation for Windows — capture, OCR, translate, overlay.

platforms.label: Windows ARM64
platforms.description: Snapdragon and other ARM Windows PCs

features.title: Screen-region capture
features.description: Select the subtitle band once; the app watches that region while you watch.

features.title: Windows OCR
features.description: Uses the built-in Windows OCR engine — no cloud vision API.

features.title: On-device translation
features.description: HY-MT runs locally after a one-time model download (~1.1 GB). Subtitle text stays on your machine.

features.title: Floating overlay
features.description: Translated lines render in an always-on-top overlay you can position over the video.

features.title: ARM64 GPU path
features.description: Validated Adreno configurations can offload inference to the GPU with CPU fallback.

features.title: In-app updates
features.description: Check for updates from Settings; downloads are signature-verified before install.

engineering: Tauri 2 desktop shell with Rust backend and a multi-webview frontend (main, selector, overlay, setup wizard).
End-to-end pipeline: capture → preprocess → OCR → normalize/dedupe → local translation → validate → overlay.
App-managed engine lifecycle: download, integrity checks, transactional install, rollback, repair.
Evidence-backed ARM64 acceleration policy with hardware/driver gating and CPU fallback.
Privacy-safe logging and evaluation — production logs exclude subtitle text.
Dual-architecture packaging (x64 + ARM64) with automated release mirroring to this public repository.

local: Screen capture of the selected subtitle region
network: One-time download of the translation runtime and model during setup
Optional manual update checks (nothing runs until you press the button)

notes: Installers are not Authenticode-signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher.
Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS.txt attached to each release.

license.summary: This repository distributes release binaries and public documentation only. Application source code is not published here.
